chapter: Favorite bands, advice and family reflections
title: John Hammond's millionaire support of jazz
summary: Hammond never played an instrument but pushed bandleaders by offering money.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: For loving jazz so much. He was a millionaire. And he's been a millionaire ever since I met him. And I have never seen him play an instrument. But, he'd go around and what he thinks he wants he'd get for somebody else. He'd say to this band leader I want him to change, I'll give him some more money. He'd change. And I've seen him. And I've seen it done.
